project_info.name: MerqON
project_info.vibe: Ultra-premium international DeFi exchange aesthetic. High-density data metrics, sleek dark obsidian surfaces, warm metallic gold & cyber emerald accents, crisp typography, non-generic Web3 institutional financial product.

design_identity.theme: Dark Mode First (Obsidian & Metallic BNB Gold)
design_identity.archetype: The Performance Pro & High-Contrast Swiss DeFi
design_identity.emotional_tone: Institutional trust, financial precision, technological prestige, mathematical transparency
core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Synthesize Bloomberg-style financial density with high-end Apple crystal glass and Web3 neon tracing accents.
Emotion First: Every visual state signals high value security and financial growth, avoiding cheap MLM tropes.
Content is King: Narrative flow moves from Instant Web3 Connectivity -> Live Wallet Metrics -> Dual Tree Network Intelligence -> Income Engine Breakdown -> Transparent BSC Ledger.
Data Density & Clarity: High contrast numerical displays with JetBrains Mono, clear badge indicators, and zero layout clutter.
Asymmetry & Tension: Bento grids with non-uniform card ratios for high visual engagement.

rules: DO NOT use Inter for main headings — use Outfit or Plus Jakarta Sans.
Use JetBrains Mono for all token balances, fiat amounts, wallet addresses, transaction hashes, and APY rates.
Overlines / badges MUST be uppercase with wide letter spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Headlines > 32px MUST use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
NEVER use pure black #000000; tint background greys with deep navy/obsidian #07090E.
Buttons & active state hovers MUST explicitly declare hover text color (e.g. hover:bg-amber-400 hover:text-slate-950).
Maintain minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all analytical text.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8
rules: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
All grid children in Framer Motion MUST have the grid span classes attached directly to motion.div.
Sidebar layout must be sticky with smooth collapsibility for desktop and drawer for mobile.

surface_strategies.beam_card: relative rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-900/90 to-slate-950/90 border border-amber-500/20 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden

key_functionalities.description: MetaMask / WalletConnect modal simulation with cryptographic nonce signing, address formatting (0x12...abcd), and BSC network status badge.
MERQ token balance, live fiat valuation ($USD), income summary cards (Referral, Profit Growth, Autopool, Rewards), quick action buttons (Deposit, Withdraw, Refer).
Interactive switchable viewer for Sponsor Tree (unilevel direct referrals) and Placement Tree (binary left/right leg structure with volume counters).
Breakdown of 5 income streams (Referral Income, Profit Growth, Profit Growth Commission, Achievement Rewards, Autopool Matrix), filterable history table.
Global matrix tier progression visualizer, slot status, auto-fill queue position, and claimable pool rewards.
Tiered milestone cards (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond, Ambassador) with progress bars, locked/unlocked states, and claim reward triggers.
BEP-20 token approval flow simulation, deposit tier selection, gas estimation indicator, and transaction confirmation drawer.
Available MERQ balance check, dynamic withdrawal fee calculation (e.g. 5% pool maintenance fee), net payout preview, and signature confirmation.
Table displaying off-chain MongoDB ledger transactions with simulated 0x tx hashes linked directly to BscScan testnet/mainnet explorer format.
Configurable rule sets (referral percentage, pool release caps, binary leg balance requirements, deposit packages) and member status override.

instructions_to_main_agent: Components are in JavaScript (.jsx / .js files). Do NOT output TypeScript types or .tsx extensions.
Use Lucide React or @phosphor-icons/react for modern crypto dashboard icons.
Use Sonner (src/components/ui/sonner.jsx) for all toast notifications (e.g. Wallet Connected, Signature Verified, Transaction Submitted, Referral Link Copied).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind CSS for custom structural layouts and custom SVG elements for the binary tree visualization.
All modals, datepickers, selects, tabs, and tables must use customized Shadcn primitives in src/components/ui/.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, on distribution outputs. In frontend design, this creates AI slop. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as heavy full-screen gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions like transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button or input, excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the main app container (.App text-align: center).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or sharp border buttons with subtle gold glow animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use clean SVG / Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels typical to allow high data density breathing room.
Subtle grain textures, selection states, glowing borders, and loading skeletons separate good from extraordinary.
